sentences.text:
THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 20.11.2025,
THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 W.P.(C)No.26049 of 2025  2025:KER:90924  2  JUDGMENT Dated this the 20th day of November, 2025 This writ petition is filed seeking the following reliefs;
"a) Issue a writ of mandamus or other appropriate writ or order directing the 4th respondent to provide adequate and effective protection to the petitioner's Resort situated in Sy. No. 61/9/1 of KDH Village, her staff and guests from any untoward action at the hands of respondents 1 to 3 and their supporters,
b) Issue a writ of mandamus or other appropriate writ or order directing the 4 th respondent to take immediate action on Exhibit P-9 complaint submitted by the petitioner."
2. On 17.07.2025, this Court passed an interim order directing the 4th respondent to give protection to the petitioner to run her resort for a period of two weeks.
This Court also observed that the order shall not be used in any manner to resolve any civil dispute.

The order was challenged by respondents 1 and 3 and the Writ Appeal 2025:KER:90924 was disposed of by judgment dated 12.09.2025, setting aside the interim order and granting liberty to the petitioner to seek relief,
including the grant of Police protection, in the pending First Appeal.
In the light of the Division Bench judgment, the reliefs sought in the writ petition cannot be granted.
The writ petition is hence closed, leaving it open for the parties to seek appropriate remedies.
